[[Dynamos (South Africa)|Dynamos]] | matches = 442 | total goals = 543 | average goals = | league topscorer = [[Lesvin Stoffels]] and [[Nkosinathi Mthiyane]] (14) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2011–12 National First Division|2011–12]] | nextseason = [[2013–14 National First Division|2013–14]] }} The '''2012–13 National First Division''' was played from September 2012 until May 2013, and is the second tier of South Africa's professional [[association football|football]]. [[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]] won the league, earning promotion to the [[2013–14 South African Premiership|2013–14 Premiership]]. [[Santos F.C. (South Africa)|Santos]] and [[Mpumalanga Black Aces F.C.|Mpumalanga Black Aces]] finished second and third respectively, qualifying for the [[2012–13 National First Division#PSL playoff tournament|2012–13 PSL Playoff Tournament]], which Mpumalanga Black Aces won, also earning them promotion to the [[2013–14 South African Premiership|2013–14 Premiership]]. Clubs played a varying number of games over the course of the season due to a number of boycotts which took place at the beginning of the season.{{Cite web |url=http://www.soccerladuma.co.za/leagues/tables/national-first-division-2012-2013 |title = National First Division 2012/13 {{!}} Soccer Laduma |access-date=2013-11-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131104140253/http://www.soccerladuma.co.za/leagues/tables/national-first-division-2012-2013 |archive-date=2013-11-04 |url-status=dead }}{{Cite web|url=http://www.futbol24.com/national/South-Africa/National-First-Division/2012-2013/|title = South Africa - National First Division - Results, fixtures, tables, statistics - Futbol24}} The results faced legal disputes by [[Thanda Royal Zulu F.C.|Thanda Royal Zulu]] and [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] which were eventually dismissed, and the trophy was only handed to Polokwane City at the start of the following season.{{Cite web |last=KickOff |title=Polokwane City National First Division winners trophy |url=https://www.snl24.com/kickoff/sanews/premiership/polokwane-city-national-first-division-winners-trophy-20130823 |access-date=2025-02-15 |website=Kickoff |date=23 August 2013 |language=en-US}} ==League table== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PR |team1=POL|name_POL=[[Polokwane City F.C.|Polokwane City]] |team2=SAN|name_SAN=[[Santos F.C.
